mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (measured as the current monthly value) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or the average 20-day return in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day SPX return in instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales, measured as both series exceeding their 3-month moving averages, signals strong aggregate demand and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: The average 60-day SPX return when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the joint condition falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production growth regime (INDPRO yoy growth < 0.5%), a month-over-month decline in industrial production indicates worsening supply conditions and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day SPX return in low INDPRO growth regimes (yoy growth < 0.5%) when INDPRO declines month-over-month is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the signal in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts indicates strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or the average 20-day return in high HOUST periods (HOUST > 1400) is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in the consumer price index exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals escalating inflationary pressures, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day SPX return in instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 3 months is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market expansion regime (PAYEMS growth > 100k per month), a month-over-month increase in payroll employment signals continued economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day SPX return in strong labor market expansion regimes (PAYEMS growth > 100k) when PAYEMS increases month-over-month is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the signal in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals an economic slowdown triggered by monetary easing in response to labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to labor market deterioration
failure_condition: The average 60-day SPX return when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the joint condition falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
